entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. For questions about an existing order or to start a return, please press one. For all other inquiries, please press two.
Thanks for calling VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return a pair of shoes and maybe some tires I bought. The order number is VF8675309.

I can certainly look into that for you. Let me pull up order VF8675309... Okay, I see the VeloPro Carbon Shoes and a set of a VeloGrip tires, delivered about 25 days ago. You're well within the 90-day window. Can you tell me about the condition of the items?
Yeah, they're basically new. I took them out for one short ride, but the shoes just aren't the right fit for me.
I understand, getting the right fit is crucial. When you say you took them for a ride, does that mean you attached cleats to the shoes?
Well yeah, how else would I test them on my bike? I had to install the cleats.

I see. Unfortunately, once a cleat has been mounted to the shoe, we are unable to accept it as a return. Our policy states that items must be in new, unused condition. Even a single installation can leave permanent cleat marks, which means we can't resell them.
What? That's ridiculous! How am I supposed to know if they fit if I can't try them? There are barely any marks on them. I can't believe this.

I do apologize for the frustration. I know it's a difficult policy. We consider any item that has been installed as used. The same would apply to the tires; if they were put on a wheel and ridden, we wouldn't be able to take them back, especially if they came back as dirty tires.
Unbelievable. So now I'm just stuck with a hundred and fifty dollars worth of gear I can't even use? This is the last time I order from VeloFit.

I truly don't want this to be your last experience with us. While I can't override the policy on used items—I cannot accept shoes once the cleats are mounted—I want to find a way to help you. What I can do is offer you a $30 VeloFit store credit to help offset the cost of a new pair that will work for you.
Thirty dollars? The shoes cost way more than that. That barely helps.

You're right, and I completely understand your position. I want to make sure you get into the right gear and feel good about shopping with us. I can stretch that to a $50 credit, which is the maximum I'm authorized to offer. You can use it on a different pair of shoes, or anything else you might need.
Fifty dollars? Okay... well, I appreciate that. That's better than nothing, I suppose. It would definitely help with a new pair.

Excellent. I'm happy we could find a solution. I've just applied that $50 credit directly to your VeloFit account. It's available for you to use right now and never expires. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's it. Thank you for your help, Alex. I really do appreciate you doing that.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
